source.binding: A complete briefing with no technical detail; a change window bearing his signature; no finding that names the signature as a cause.
source.seal: An open enclosure held inside two closed rings; the centre is empty.
source.actual_effect: Withheld the only effective authority until the deadline passed, then asked why the operator had waited.
journey: There was no one at the final desk. A lamp on it announced that the office was available. The ticket pressed the lamp. It changed to engaged.

At the side of the desk was an emergency passage. Its handle was behind the desk. A notice explained that access to the handle was available in emergencies upon approval. The ticket put its four receipts into the slot.

When Bael arrived he asked for the shortest possible account. The ticket gave him its number. He asked why no one had exercised judgment. The ticket looked for Foras, who was six floors away with one finger raised. A new ticket was opened to establish when Foras had known.
source.parable: The archive held five routes to the spring. Four required the same key. The fifth required the keeper of the key to certify that no key was needed.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one raster figure reference for Librum Quinque, NOT a complete plate.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED FORAS STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its fine black pen/engraving line, cellular openwork, lattice membranes, slender jointed anatomy and vertical hanging lines ending in tiny dots. Do not copy Foras's identity, six arms, pose or objects. Invent the specified individual subject in the same drawing hand and same scale of fine line.
Portrait PNG, 2:3, target 2048 x 3072 if available. Flat unbleached cream ground #ede6d4 across the entire image, no texture gradients, no vignette. Figure alone centred, entirely visible, body about 76-80 percent of page height, generous clear cream margins above, below and to both sides. No environment unless the specified attribute attaches to the figure.
Palette strictly limited: near-black #161918 lines; ONE SINGLE red #a32b24 intervention identified below; sparse muted slate blue-grey #4f6f7a inside small garment or device cells and a little ochre line. Red occurs nowhere else. Paper shows through most cells. Dense intricate pen bundles and delicate hatching within ornament, open air outside. Line art with only very light flat wash at most. NO painterly shading, shadows cast on paper, photography, lighting effects, glossy metal, 3D rendering. NO text whatsoever, NO letters, NO numerals, NO writing or pseudo-writing, NO frames, captions, borders, decorative page layouts or watermarks. Any papers have blank surfaces. No extra figures.

INDIVIDUAL SUBJECT — BAEL:
Chief Technology Officer — THE EMPTY SEAT. No person, demon, face, ghost, eyes, silhouette, hands, human-shaped absence or occupant. The portrait consists ONLY of a solitary EMPTY high-backed chair and its seal. The chair has no identifiable front: a rotationally ambiguous narrow seat with paired lattice back-like structures seen at a gentle three-quarter angle, four slender architectural legs. Everything fully visible on blank cream ground. Chair skeleton drawn with the same fine pen and rich cellular/lattice ornament as Foras's robe, some sparse slate and tiny ochre in structural cells, vertical black drop-lines ending in dots. A pendant seal suspended in the empty space above the seat: TWO CLOSED BLACK concentric rings holding ONE OPEN enclosure; the exact centre remains entirely blank cream. The SINGLE red intervention is the OPEN enclosure inside those black rings, red line only. No other red. No desk, calendar, crown, surrounding architecture or writing. Empty seat remains clearly visible, not filled by ornament.
Canonical catalogue attribute (do not print these words): He appeareth forty minutes late, or as a calendar marked private. His chair hath a high back and no identifiable front.
Canonical office effect for conceptual guidance only (no written text in image): Withheld the only effective authority until the deadline passed, then asked why the operator had waited.
attempts.qa_notes: Empty four-legged chair; final pendant has two closed black rings and separate open red enclosure; no occupant.
attempts.reason_for_next_attempt: Red enclosure closed; two outer black rings not separately resolved.

1. Replace only the circular pendant seal above the empty seat with TWO clearly separated, thin, CLOSED near-black #161918 concentric rings. Inside BOTH black rings draw a third, smaller red #a32b24 C-shaped enclosure with a conspicuous OPEN GAP of about a quarter of its circumference at lower right. The red curve is NOT a complete ring; it has two unjoined ends. There is cream space between every ring. Entire central disk stays empty cream. Only this one red C, no other red.
2. Give the COMPLETE chair and hanging seal more open air on the same 2:3 portrait sheet: reduce the whole composition modestly to leave at least 8 percent blank cream margin at top and bottom and 12 percent at each side, never crop a line.
No text, numbers, frames, captions, border, gradient, paper texture or additional objects. PNG, retain portrait 2:3. Preserve all other drawing detail.
